about: The mic-mode invariant (4-9, launch-gate 2026-11-14): after ANY mic-mode change the mic ends MUTED unless the person explicitly unmuted it. Each scenario starts out of push to talk with the mic muted, in a call; after each step `live` = the mic transmits. Events: pttOn / pttOff (the setting, also its call-bar button), holdDown / holdUp (the key; the release tail is its own test), muteToggle (the mic button), deviceSwitch, leave, join (a next call), afkOn / afkOff (BRB). baseFails = the 12.1.15 rules get this scenario wrong (the control). Byte-identical: desktop crates/app/src/testvectors/mic-mode.json (owner; mic_mode.rs), web src/features/calls/testvectors/mic-mode.json (micMode.ts).

scenarios.name: 4-9: push to talk turned OFF mid-hold: muted, and stays muted after the release
push to talk turned ON mid-talk (mic unmuted by hand): muted
a mute toggle during a hold is the person's: muted; the release keeps it muted
two mute toggles during a hold: open while held, muted at the release
a device switch during a hold: still held, muted at the release
4-9: leaving during a hold ends it: the next call starts muted
U1: BRB during a hold mutes; a press while away opens nothing; back from BRB still muted
4-9: push to talk off then on mid-hold: muted all along
control: unmuted by hand, then push to talk on and off: muted
control: a plain hold and release
4-9 (review): unmuted by hand, BRB, push to talk on and off, back from BRB: muted (the mode change drops BRB's restore)
